friend.speaker: A
lines: {A} tosses {B} a ration bar without even looking. {B} catches it without looking either.
{A} checks on {B} between breaths. {B} gives the old signal back: fine, still standing.
{A} covers {B}'s blind side out of pure habit by now.
{A} cracks a joke only {B} would get. {B} laughs before the punchline even lands.
{A} and {B} fall into step without a word passing between them.
{A} watches {B}'s back the way you only do for someone you trust with your life.
reply: Wouldn't have it any other way, {A}.
You'd do the same for me, {A}.
We've got each other, {A}. Always have.

rival.speaker: A
lines: {A} takes the lead just to keep it away from {B}. {B} notices. {B} always notices.
{A} makes a point of not needing {B}'s help. {B} makes a point of offering it anyway.
{A} and {B} both reach for the same call, and neither backs down first.
{A} mutters something under their breath about {B}. {B} mutters something back.
{A} keeps score. {B} keeps score too, just quieter about it.
{A} and {B} stand shoulder to shoulder and somehow still feel like they're on opposite sides.
reply: Save it for after the mission, {A}.
